Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Here’s a simple starting point:
Whiskey — rich and warming; often tastes of vanilla, caramel, spice, fruit, or smoke. Main styles include Bourbon, Rye, and Scotch.
Tequila — made in styles from bright, unaged Blanco/Silver to lightly barrel-aged Reposado, which has a softer amber character.
Rum — made from sugarcane or molasses; can be light and tropical, or darker, richer, and spicier.
Gin — crisp and botanical, usually led by juniper; great if you enjoy fresh, herbal, citrusy drinks.
Vodka — clear and neutral in style, making it an easy choice for simple mixed drinks.
Brandy — fruit-forward and warming, often with a smooth, rounded character.
Flaviar carries all of these categories, from familiar classics to craft and rare bottles.
